name: loveengine-witness
description: SCC0-licensed pilot distribution wrapper for the LoveEngine Witness Skill. It never stores private keys, never auto-approves votes, and treats SkillRegistry package hashes as the protocol trust root.

interface.shortDescription: Install, join, observe, and audit LoveEngine witness pilots.
interface.longDescription: LoveEngine Witness is a Codex-facing pilot plugin for verifying manifests, joining invite-based LAN/Tailscale pilots, operating live-text evidence sessions, and auditing transcripts. It is a distribution entrypoint only; the protocol trust root remains the on-chain SkillRegistry package hash.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the LoveEngine Witness workflow. First verify the manifest/package, then identify my role and provide the safe next command.
